info.description:
Cloud-native Manufacturing Execution System API for phygital fabrication.
Provides endpoints for order management, task/Kanban board operations,
machine control, telemetry, quality management, and real-time updates.
info.title: PravaraMES API

get.description: Returns a paginated list of orders with optional filtering by status, priority, and date range

parameters.description: Filter by order status (canonical DB enum; legacy aliases confirmed/processing/in_production/quality_check/ready/delivered are normalized)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates a new order in received status. Items may be supplied inline; each becomes an order item, and when orders.auto_decompose is enabled every item also spawns a production task (with capability-based machine auto-assignment when orders.auto_assign is enabled). Without items the response is the bare order; with items it is {order, items, tasks_created}.

parameters.description: Order creation data (optionally with inline items and shipping_address)
parameters.name: body

201.description: Created order (or {order, items, tasks_created} when inline items were supplied)

get.description: Returns a single order with all details

put.description: Updates order fields including status. Status accepts the canonical enum values (received, validated, scheduled, in_progress, completed, shipped, cancelled); legacy aliases (confirmed, processing, in_production, quality_check, ready, delivered) are normalized onto them. Unknown statuses are rejected with 400. A status change publishes order.status_changed.

get.description: Returns all items for a specific order

post.description: Adds a new line item to an existing order. When orders.auto_decompose is enabled the item also spawns its production task (with capability-based machine auto-assignment when orders.auto_assign is enabled).

shipping_address.description:
ShippingAddress holds delivery details as free-form JSON
(e.g. line1, line2, city, state, postal_code, country, contact_name,
contact_phone). Backed by orders.shipping_address (migration 025).
